preText: M Siddharth to bowl first up, Ganga to take strike. Chepauk Super Gillies won the toss and elected to field Lyca Kovai Kings V Ganga Sridhar Raju, J Suresh Kumar†, B Sai Sudharsan, PS Chandran, M Shahrukh Khan*, U Mukilesh, AB Tanwar, V Yudheeshwaran, Manish Ravi, S Ajith Ram, B Surya Chepauk Super Gillies KM Gandhi*, N Jagadeesan†, S Radhakrishnan, R Sai Kishore, U Sasidev, R Sathish, S Harish Kumar, R Sonu Yadav, M Siddharth, S Sandeep Warrier, R Alexandar 20:50 local We have some good news, play to start at 21:15 local, it is going to be 17 overs game. 5 overs of powerplay. 2 bowlers can bowl 4 overs and 3 bowlers can bowl 3 overs. 20:49 local is the cut off time for any reduction of overs. Duvvu Ramesh Ku: "Is It Raining Or OutField Issue? Plz Update It Guys From Vizag City( AP State ) India." - Wet outfield. 20:15 local: The umpires had an inspection at 20:00 local and there is some improvement in the conditions and the ground. There will be another inspection at 20:30 local. Sathya: "If rain washed out the match. Is there a reserve day?" Don't think there is a reserve day. Nishanth: "Bro Enna bro innam start pannala seri innaikku yaru win pannuva bro " 19:17 local: Till 20:49 local there will be no reduction of overs. 19:07 local: The rain seem to have eased, good crowd building up. The super sopper is out and doing its work. The drying up process is on. Hello and welcome to the Final of the TNPL 2022. The news from the middle is that it has been raining.
